verses.2: Son of man, set thy face against mount
verses.3: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount
verses.4: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.5: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of
verses.6: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
verses.8: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.9: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.10: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:
verses.11: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
verses.12: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of
verses.13: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
verses.14: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
